name: comp-307
title: Feature Launch Banner
description: A full-width dark strip announcing a launch, with a white Download button, a plain Learn more link and a close X that hides the bar.
use: You want a slim launch announcement with a primary download action and a dismiss control.
avoid: The message and buttons are fixed and dismissal is not stored, so the bar returns on reload.
a11y: Close is labelled and icons are hidden, but the file adds no focus style of its own and ignores reduced motion. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A very thin, full-width dark band sits at the top, holding one small line of light text on the left. On the right are a white rounded Download button, a borderless Learn more label and a faint X.
behaves: Pressing the X removes the band. Learn more underlines and the X brightens on hover; the demo never presses Download.
customise: The message, button labels and targets are fixed in the file; only the visible flag is local state.
weight: light: A single thin band with one state flag and a hover transition.
demo: It's live and ready to use! Start exploring the latest addition to your toolkit.
issues: The clip crops the left edge, cutting the leading icon and opening words.
Download and Learn more have no handlers, so neither action does anything.
polishWhy: Tidy, compact launch strip; cropped edge and inert buttons keep it ordinary.

frames.note: The crop cuts the left edge, so the leading icon and the opening words are missing.
